reviews.title: Great idea! HORRIFIC Execution!!
reviews.text:
This is such a great idea of an app but it is executed TERRIBLY. If I could have given this a ZERO star, I would have.

1st. The number of repeat names we get is absolutely insane. We both have swiped left on the same names sometimes 5-6 times in a row. Before seeing it another 2-3 times just a few names later. How does it not keep actual track of the names we have disliked?
2nd. The “Means” section of the cards where it lists the meaning of names are so impossibly incorrect it’s actually funny.
3rd. How on EARTH are the names not alphabetical in the matched section?? Also, it mentions a search feature but I can’t find anything that allows filtering in the “Matches” tab.
4th. $8 for A MONTHLY MEMBERSHIP for an app like this is highway robbery. The features mentioned should be so simple to implement & I would expect them in a free app. Laughable how terribly this is put together.

Final conclusion, if there is another app that does the same “Partner linking name swiping” thing that this app claims it does, without having heard of it or used it I can confidently recommend it over this half assed Ai trash. We will be looking for a refund immediately.

There is no search function and you can only use one filter at a time—both of which seem like pretty basic features. It also annoys me that you can’t opt to see names in alphabetical order rather than randomized (especially since there’s no search function).

reviews.title: Super Buggy - 0 out of 5 stars in its current state.
reviews.text:
This app may have worked in the past, but it no longer seems to work today. It is extremely buggy.

Cannot connect with my partner:
The app gives you a shareable link to send to your partner or anyone you want to match names with. The link sends you to the app store whether the app is already installed or not. Even after opening through the app store, the link does not connect you and your partner.

Recycled names:
The app repeats names very quickly. I saw Sophia, Henry and Noah constantly, even after subscribing. I subscribed hoping that would resolve the issue. It did not.

Overall UI experience:
The bugs and outdated design make an otherwise wonderful idea feel much less effective.

At this point, I am starting to believe that Noah, Henry and Sophia are the actual builders of this app and this is all a conspiracy to make everyone pick one of their names.
